title: Structural probe value from evidence root-cut gain

known_answer.baseline: two transcript contexts sharing one frozen axis root; role root-cut = 1
known_answer.equal_cost_ranking: orthogonal probe ranks above same-axis replication

invariants: Replication value depends on which dependencies are shared

boundary: Root-cut gain is a structural robustness metric only. It does not estimate biological truth probability, effect size, clinical utility, or ethical/financial cost unless those are separately modeled.
